title: Biotorch: A Unified PyTorch Automl Library for Biological Sequences, Networks and Graphs
content: Modernized deep learning includes sequence models, graph neural networks and domain specific analysis. We present biotorch, a PyTorch-based Python package that handles biological sequences (DNA, RNA, protein), biological networks (protein–protein interaction, gene regulatory, metabolic and other typed, weighted or directed networks) and graphs (protein structures, molecules, de Bruijn graphs) under one interface. Each and every model exposes batch method, which allows the users to automate classification, regression, per-residue labelling, masked language modelling, node classification, link prediction, graph classification and sequence-network fusion. The package include synthetic benchmarks.  biotorch is written in Python (≥3.9) and distributed as an installable package. Source code, documentation and tests: https://github.com/sablokg/biotorch. License: MIT. The package was developed and tested with Python 3.12 and PyTorch 2.14 on CPU.
